title: File:Grover-Chambers House -- Galveston.jpg
desc:
All outside and interior walls are brick from Brown’s brick yard that was located on the western edge of the city. They are 16 inches thick. The exterior is covered with concrete, while the interior is of plaster of Paris, with 12-inch handmade moldings.
A large drawing room or parlor is 20×40 feet.
